newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Econ Ministry details pan-German Q4 GDP.
newsitem.headline: German Econ Ministry details pan-German Q4 GDP.

text.p: The Economics Ministry gave the following qtr/qtr details for Q3 pan-German GDP. The Federal Statistics Office had earlier given the year/year figures:

NOTE - Quarter-on-quarter figures are adjusted for inflation (1991 prices) and for seasonal and calendar factors. They are rounded to the nearest half pct point. The inventory figures show the amount of GDP accounted for by stock changes, not the change in stocks from the previous quarter. Previously announced data in brackets.
